parse.title: Morytania Diary
parse.wikitext:
===Rewards===
*[[Morytania legs 4]]:
**Prevents [[ghast]]s from turning your [[food]] into [[rotten food]] when worn
**Unlimited teleports to the [[Pool of Slime]] beneath the [[Ectofuntus]]
*[[Antique lamp (elite)|Antique lamp]] worth 50,000 experience in any skill of at least level 70
*[[Robin]] exchanges 39 [[Remains#Bones|bones]] of any kind daily for a [[bucket of slime]] and a pot of [[bonemeal]] each, up from 26
*50% more [[Firemaking]] experience when burning [[shade remains]]
*Bones buried via the [[Bonecrusher]] now grant full [[Prayer]] experience
*Access to the disease-free [[herb patch]] on [[Harmony Island]]
*10% more [[Slayer]] experience in the [[Slayer Tower]] while on a [[Slayer task]], up from 7.5%
